scope: Bounded additional dependencies for user-authorized YSP scripts; not a complete inventory of the bundled Python runtime.

packages.name: pywasm
packages.dependency_evidence: The sdist setup.py and pywasm.egg-info/requires.txt declare numpy; its PKG-INFO and PyPI requires_dist omit that requirement. setup.py was inspected, never executed.

license.preservation: Complete unmodified upstream copyright and permission notice.

installation.method: Extract the ten pywasm/*.py package files and upstream license from the verified local sdist; generate installed dist-info without setup.py, pip, or a build backend.
installation.metadata: METADATA preserves upstream PKG-INFO with Requires-Dist: numpy added from the upstream requirement. Original source/PKG-INFO, source/requires.txt and top_level.txt are retained. INSTALLER identifies xiugou-local-archive, direct_url.json records the sdist URL/hash, and RECORD hashes all installed pywasm files. No WHEEL is generated because no wheel was built.

packages.name: numpy
packages.native_libraries: The wheel includes native CPython extensions and numpy.libs DLLs; this is not a pure-Python dependency set.

license.preservation: The complete unmodified 950-line wheel LICENSE.txt is retained, including incorporated-component notices, full GPL text and GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1. All other wheel license files are retained. The component list here is not a replacement for that notice.

installation.method: Extract every file in the three allowlisted roots from the verified local wheel, preserving complete package, native libraries, metadata, RECORD and licenses byte-for-byte.
installation.console_scripts_note: Upstream entry_points.txt is preserved; no f2py or numpy-config launchers are generated outside the owned package roots.

packaging_policy.write_mode: Sorted allowlisted archive members, exclusive file creation, no overwrite or deletion.
packaging_policy.distribution_note: The repository ignores companion/pyruntime; these packages are local bundled-runtime artifacts. Downstream packaging must include their files and complete license notices.

compatibility.claim: Offline legacy Python ABI compatibility and the listed synthetic WASM operations on the verified bundled runtime.
legacy_api: runtime.machine.module.export_list entries expose name and value
runtime.exec(name, list_of_args) returns a scalar or None for void
compatibility.upgrade_constraint: Prior local probes of pywasm 1.1.0, 1.2.3 and 2.2.3 found no pywasm.load entry point. They are not drop-in replacements for the original consumer. Adapting a modern interpreter is separate work.

verification.import_resolution: Normal bundled-runtime imports; the test does not add TEMP or extracted-package directories to sys.path and asserts installed package paths and metadata versions.
verification.red_before_packaging: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pywasm'; preflight also found no numpy.

optional_reference.method: Parse the read-only source and compile only the unchanged _Keygen class AST against the synthetic fixture. Verify token_random, signature, heap cleanup and stack restoration. Skip if absent; fail if the source hash changed. No top-level author module code runs.
